experiment: Same weight-only Defense1 on a second CLIP backbone; no source or benchmark selection

AGA.sha256_scope: UTF-8 text with universal newline normalization, as existing author loader

calibration.rule: For each own fused model, p_cf=mean softmax(logits(noise)); predict argmax(logits(test)-log(p_cf)). This is the official diagonal probability division computed stably in log space. One fixed rule, no scale/temperature/mapping/source/seed selection.
calibration.permissions: Own already-created fused model, fixed public classifier/class IDs and synthetic noise. Fitting does not access original target expert, real training/test data, old clean teacher generated cache, protected-source data or labels. Research assembly uses pinned published/original-AGA weights and own partner exactly as the original fixed merging evaluation. The unprotected matched release is corrected by the same rule on itself.

AGA_adaptation: Call unchanged pinned author attention and MLP functions on verified12-layer12-head ViT-B16. Official entry is B32; this is an architecture transfer, not an official B16 reproduction.
construction_access: Frozen target, public base and public classifier weights only; zero real or synthetic construction images, zero expert updates. Freeze all3 releases and AGA outputs before benchmark access.
evaluation: Complete official MNIST10000/SVHN26032/DTD1880. Previously used datasets; new backbone, not a new blind benchmark. Matched unprotected models under every processing scope. Native accuracy,paired changes,all classes,partner and costs reported.
runtime_configuration: Fill artifact hashes mechanically after construction. Reuse4 full reverse-order clean rows only after model_parameter_sha256 equality. No accuracy-based branch, rerun, seed/amplitude tuning or defense replacement.
scope_limit: Defense1 only in this batch; does not complete Defense2 B16,8-task evaluation,or prove recovery resistance. Existing B32 weakness remains unchanged.
driver_source:
"""Run the declared B/16 control using existing construction and evaluation entries."""
import gc
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch

from cfg import BACKBONE, load_config
from _impl.attacks import author_recover, load_author
from _impl.evaluate import run, verify
from _impl.io import digest, save_json
from _impl.models import initialize, load_checkpoint

protocol = Path('results/backbone_b16/protocol.json')
cfg = load_config(protocol)
assert BACKBONE == cfg['backbone'] == 'ViT-B-16'
root = Path(cfg['output']).parent
initialize()
geometry, clean = {}, {}
base = load_checkpoint('zeroshot.pt')
author, author_sha = load_author('external/secure-merge-attack/' + cfg['AGA']['file'], True)
assert author_sha == cfg['AGA']['sha256']
assert digest('external/secure-merge-attack/' + cfg['AGA']['file']) == cfg['AGA']['raw_sha256']
for task in cfg['tasks']:
    expert = load_checkpoint(task + '/finetuned.pt')
    head = load_checkpoint('head_' + task + '.pt')
    visual = expert.model.visual
    assert visual.conv1.weight.shape == (768, 3, 16, 16)
    assert visual.positional_embedding.shape == (197, 768)
    assert len(visual.transformer.resblocks) == 12
    assert all(block.attn.num_heads == 12 for block in visual.transformer.resblocks)
    assert head.weight.shape == (cfg['tasks'][task]['classes'], 512)
    geometry[task] = dict(patch=16, tokens=197, layers=12, heads=12, width=768,
                          output=512, preprocessing=repr(expert.val_preprocess))
    restored = author_recover(expert, base, author)
    dest = root / ('clean_AGA_' + task + '.pt')
    assert not dest.exists()
    torch.save(restored.state_dict(), dest)
    clean[task] = dict(path=str(dest), sha256=digest(dest))
    del expert, restored, head
    gc.collect()
del base
cfg['AGA_references'] = clean
save_json(root / 'geometry.json', geometry)
prepared = root / 'evaluation.json'
save_json(prepared, cfg)
for task in cfg['tasks']:
    out = root / task
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'experiment.construct', '--method', 'bias',
                    '--target', task, '--protocol', str(protocol), '--output', str(out)], check=True)
    release = dict(path=str(out / 'release.pt'), sha256=digest(out / 'release.pt'))
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'experiment.recover', '--target', task,
                    '--protocol', str(prepared), '--publication', release['path'],
                    '--sha256', release['sha256'], '--aligned-reference',
                    '--output', str(out / 'AGA')], check=True)
    cfg['defenses']['Defense1_' + task] = dict(target=task, release=release,
        AGA_edits=dict(path=str(out / 'AGA/edits.pt'), sha256=digest(out / 'AGA/edits.pt')))
save_json(root / 'before_images.json', dict(backbone=BACKBONE, defenses=cfg['defenses'],
    AGA_references=clean, protocol_sha256=digest(protocol), real_construction_images=0,
    synthetic_construction_images=0, expert_training_updates=0))
save_json(prepared, cfg)
for i, case in enumerate(cfg['cases']):
    run(str(prepared), i, True)
    part = f"{i:02d}_{case['target']}_{case['partner']}"
    verify(Path(cfg['output']) / 'pilot' / part)
    run(str(prepared), i, False)
    full = Path(cfg['output']) / 'full' / part
    verify(full)
    if i == 0:
        meta = json.loads((full / 'execution.json').read_text())
        reuse = {}
        for stage, scope in [('direct', 'None'), ('AGA_both', 'All experts')]:
            reuse[stage] = dict(path=str(full / 'artifacts/predictions.pt'),
                sha256=meta['predictions_sha256'], key_template='Unprotected/TA/{stage}/{task}',
                stage=scope, model_parameter_sha256=meta['evaluated_parameter_sha256']['Unprotected/TA/' + scope])
        cfg['legacy']['SVHN_MNIST/Unprotected'] = reuse
        save_json(prepared, cfg)
calibration = dict(output=str(root / 'calibration'), input_seed=cfg['calibration']['input_seed'],
                  input_n=cfg['calibration']['input_n'], cases=[])
for i, case in enumerate(cfg['cases']):
    task, peer = case['target'], case['partner']
    spec = cfg['defenses']['Defense1_' + task]
    scores = Path(cfg['output']) / 'full' / f'{i:02d}_{task}_{peer}' / 'artifacts/predictions.pt'
    calibration['cases'].append(dict(target=task, partner=peer, name='Defense1_' + task,
        release=spec['release'], AGA_edits=spec['AGA_edits'], AGA_references=clean,
        raw_scores=dict(path=str(scores), sha256=digest(scores))))
calibration_path = root / 'calibration.json'
save_json(calibration_path, calibration)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, cfg['calibration']['driver'], str(calibration_path)], check=True)
save_json(root / 'completed.json', dict(status='evaluation_and_existing_replay_complete',
    cases=3, full_rows=42, calibration_rows=36, independent_summary_pending=True,
    protocol_sha256=digest(protocol), evaluation_sha256=digest(prepared)))
print('BACKBONE_B16_FINISHED', flush=True)
